developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_storage_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Enable Storage Box Encrypted Subaccounts & ZFS Snapshots (Tier-3 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: BSI C5 Cloud Standard, SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_volume"
  not r.change.after.encryption
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure encryption for compliance standard BSI C5 Cloud Standard", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_audit_telemetry_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Mandate Real-Time Action Log Collection & Telemetry (Tier-4 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, EU Sovereign Cloud
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_network"
  not r.change.after.metrics
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure metrics for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_tls_enforcement_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-5 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_load_balancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure tls_enabled for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_private_networking_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-6 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure network_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_firewall_whitelist_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-7 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: BSI C5 Cloud Standard, SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_firewall"
  not r.change.after.rules
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure rules for compliance standard BSI C5 Cloud Standard", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_ssh_key_only_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Enforce ED25519 SSH Key Authentication without Passwords (Tier-8 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, EU Sovereign Cloud
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_ssh_key"
  not r.change.after.public_key
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure public_key for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Repudiation: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_automated_backups_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules (Tier-9 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.backups
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure backups for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Hetzner Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Hetzner Backup Schedule"]
      requirement["Hetzner Backup Schedule: Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-iam", label: "Hetzner API token and project permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: HTZ-BP-0494"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-backup", label: "Hetzner Backup Schedule", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-audit", label: "Hetzner Cloud action log and audit trail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_high_availability_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Enforce Anti-Affinity Spread in Placement Groups (Tier-10 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.placement_group_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure placement_group_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_storage_encryption_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Enable Storage Box Encrypted Subaccounts & ZFS Snapshots (Tier-11 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: BSI C5 Cloud Standard, SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_volume"
  not r.change.after.encryption
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure encryption for compliance standard BSI C5 Cloud Standard", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_audit_telemetry_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Mandate Real-Time Action Log Collection & Telemetry (Tier-12 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, EU Sovereign Cloud
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_network"
  not r.change.after.metrics
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure metrics for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Spoofing: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_tls_enforcement_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-1 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_load_balancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure tls_enabled for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_private_networking_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-2 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure network_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_firewall_whitelist_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-3 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: BSI C5 Cloud Standard, SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_firewall"
  not r.change.after.rules
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure rules for compliance standard BSI C5 Cloud Standard", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_ssh_key_only_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Enforce ED25519 SSH Key Authentication without Passwords (Tier-4 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, EU Sovereign Cloud
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_ssh_key"
  not r.change.after.public_key
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure public_key for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_automated_backups_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules (Tier-5 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.backups
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure backups for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Hetzner Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Hetzner Backup Schedule"]
      requirement["Hetzner Backup Schedule: Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-iam", label: "Hetzner API token and project permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: HTZ-BP-0502"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-backup", label: "Hetzner Backup Schedule", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-audit", label: "Hetzner Cloud action log and audit trail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_high_availability_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Enforce Anti-Affinity Spread in Placement Groups (Tier-6 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.placement_group_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure placement_group_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_storage_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Enable Storage Box Encrypted Subaccounts & ZFS Snapshots (Tier-7 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: BSI C5 Cloud Standard, SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_volume"
  not r.change.after.encryption
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure encryption for compliance standard BSI C5 Cloud Standard", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_audit_telemetry_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Mandate Real-Time Action Log Collection & Telemetry (Tier-8 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, EU Sovereign Cloud
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_network"
  not r.change.after.metrics
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure metrics for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Repudiation: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_tls_enforcement_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-9 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_load_balancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure tls_enabled for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_private_networking_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-10 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure network_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_firewall_whitelist_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-11 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: BSI C5 Cloud Standard, SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_firewall"
  not r.change.after.rules
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure rules for compliance standard BSI C5 Cloud Standard", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_ssh_key_only_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Enforce ED25519 SSH Key Authentication without Passwords (Tier-12 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, EU Sovereign Cloud
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_ssh_key"
  not r.change.after.public_key
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure public_key for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Spoofing: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_automated_backups_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules (Tier-1 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.backups
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure backups for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Hetzner Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Hetzner Backup Schedule"]
      requirement["Hetzner Backup Schedule: Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-iam", label: "Hetzner API token and project permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: HTZ-BP-0510"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-backup", label: "Hetzner Backup Schedule", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-audit", label: "Hetzner Cloud action log and audit trail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_high_availability_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Enforce Anti-Affinity Spread in Placement Groups (Tier-2 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.placement_group_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure placement_group_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_storage_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Enable Storage Box Encrypted Subaccounts & ZFS Snapshots (Tier-3 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: BSI C5 Cloud Standard, SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_volume"
  not r.change.after.encryption
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure encryption for compliance standard BSI C5 Cloud Standard", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_audit_telemetry_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Mandate Real-Time Action Log Collection & Telemetry (Tier-4 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, EU Sovereign Cloud
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_network"
  not r.change.after.metrics
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure metrics for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_tls_enforcement_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-5 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_load_balancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure tls_enabled for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_private_networking_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-6 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure network_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_backup.hetzner_backup_firewall_whitelist_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Backup Schedule: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-7 Automated 7-Day Rolling Backups)
# Compliance: BSI C5 Cloud Standard, SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Backup Schedule
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_firewall"
  not r.change.after.rules
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure rules for compliance standard BSI C5 Cloud Standard", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud backup list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Backup and restore integration
developer_guide.contract: Supported resource, backup schedule, retention and measured RPO/RTO
dependencies: A supported source resource and backup service role
A backup destination with explicit retention settings
steps: Configure supported backup jobs and a destination.
Monitor job completion and recovery point availability.
Restore to an isolated test target and validate application data.
tests: Restore a known dataset and compare application-level checksums.
Measure recovery time and verify failed job notifications.
failures: Backup failure: inspect service role, source support and key permissions.
Restore failure: inspect destination prerequisites and key availability.

hcloud context active
aws configure list

checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_dns.hetzner_dns_tls_enforcement_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner DNS Zone: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-1 Anycast Authoritative DNS Zones)
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner DNS Zone
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_load_balancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure tls_enabled for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud dns list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: DNS discovery and application connection
developer_guide.contract: Zone, record name, record type, answer, TTL and resolver scope
dependencies: An authoritative zone and record set
A resolver and network links for private zones
A separately reachable application endpoint
steps: Create the zone and records with deliberate TTLs.
Configure resolver scope and any private network links.
Test name resolution separately from the application connection.
tests: Query from the actual client environment and inspect the answer and TTL.
Verify a private name is only resolvable from the intended scope.
failures: NXDOMAIN: inspect zone delegation, private links and record name.
Correct answer but failed request: inspect application routing and listener.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Tampering: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner DNS Zone
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_dns.hetzner_dns_private_networking_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner DNS Zone: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-2 Anycast Authoritative DNS Zones)
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner DNS Zone
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure network_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud dns list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Hetzner Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Hetzner DNS Zone"]
      requirement["Hetzner DNS Zone: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-iam", label: "Hetzner API token and project permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: HTZ-BP-0518"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-dns", label: "Hetzner DNS Zone", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-audit", label: "Hetzner Cloud action log and audit trail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end
