threat_model.attack_vector: Elevation of Privilege: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Enforce Anti-Affinity Spread in Placement Groups

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_high_availability_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enforce Anti-Affinity Spread in Placement Groups (Tier-6 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.placement_group_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure placement_group_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Hetzner Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster"]
      requirement["Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enforce Anti-Affinity Spread in Placement Groups"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-iam", label: "Hetzner API token and project permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: HTZ-BP-0909"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-k8s", label: "Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-audit", label: "Hetzner Cloud action log and audit trail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_storage_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enable Storage Box Encrypted Subaccounts & ZFS Snapshots (Tier-7 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: BSI C5 Cloud Standard, SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_volume"
  not r.change.after.encryption
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure encryption for compliance standard BSI C5 Cloud Standard", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Tampering: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Mandate Real-Time Action Log Collection & Telemetry

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_audit_telemetry_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Mandate Real-Time Action Log Collection & Telemetry (Tier-8 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, EU Sovereign Cloud
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_network"
  not r.change.after.metrics
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure metrics for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Hetzner Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster"]
      requirement["Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Mandate Real-Time Action Log Collection & Telemetry"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-iam", label: "Hetzner API token and project permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: HTZ-BP-0911"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-k8s", label: "Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-audit", label: "Hetzner Cloud action log and audit trail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list

checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_tls_enforcement_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-9 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_load_balancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure tls_enabled for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_private_networking_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-10 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure network_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_firewall_whitelist_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-11 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: BSI C5 Cloud Standard, SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_firewall"
  not r.change.after.rules
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure rules for compliance standard BSI C5 Cloud Standard", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Hetzner Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster"]
      requirement["Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-iam", label: "Hetzner API token and project permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: HTZ-BP-0914"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-k8s", label: "Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-audit", label: "Hetzner Cloud action log and audit trail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_ssh_key_only_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enforce ED25519 SSH Key Authentication without Passwords (Tier-12 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, EU Sovereign Cloud
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_ssh_key"
  not r.change.after.public_key
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure public_key for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Spoofing: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_automated_backups_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules (Tier-1 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.backups
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure backups for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Hetzner Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster"]
      requirement["Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-iam", label: "Hetzner API token and project permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: HTZ-BP-0916"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-k8s", label: "Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-audit", label: "Hetzner Cloud action log and audit trail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_high_availability_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enforce Anti-Affinity Spread in Placement Groups (Tier-2 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.placement_group_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure placement_group_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Repudiation: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Enable Storage Box Encrypted Subaccounts & ZFS Snapshots

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_storage_encryption_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enable Storage Box Encrypted Subaccounts & ZFS Snapshots (Tier-3 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: BSI C5 Cloud Standard, SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_volume"
  not r.change.after.encryption
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure encryption for compliance standard BSI C5 Cloud Standard", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Hetzner Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster"]
      requirement["Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enable Storage Box Encrypted Subaccounts & ZFS Snapshots"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-iam", label: "Hetzner API token and project permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: HTZ-BP-0918"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-k8s", label: "Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-audit", label: "Hetzner Cloud action log and audit trail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_audit_telemetry_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Mandate Real-Time Action Log Collection & Telemetry (Tier-4 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, EU Sovereign Cloud
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_network"
  not r.change.after.metrics
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure metrics for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_tls_enforcement_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-5 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_load_balancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure tls_enabled for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end

      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}

      requirement --> check

      check -->|Yes| review

    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-k8s", label: "Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster", h: 64, pos: "b" }

    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]

      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]

      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_private_networking_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-6 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure network_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_firewall_whitelist_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-7 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: BSI C5 Cloud Standard, SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_firewall"
  not r.change.after.rules
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure rules for compliance standard BSI C5 Cloud Standard", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Tampering: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Enforce ED25519 SSH Key Authentication without Passwords

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_ssh_key_only_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enforce ED25519 SSH Key Authentication without Passwords (Tier-8 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, EU Sovereign Cloud
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_ssh_key"
  not r.change.after.public_key
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure public_key for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Hetzner Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster"]
      requirement["Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enforce ED25519 SSH Key Authentication without Passwords"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-iam", label: "Hetzner API token and project permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: HTZ-BP-0923"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-k8s", label: "Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-audit", label: "Hetzner Cloud action log and audit trail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_automated_backups_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules (Tier-9 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.backups
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure backups for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Information Disclosure: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Enforce Anti-Affinity Spread in Placement Groups

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_high_availability_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enforce Anti-Affinity Spread in Placement Groups (Tier-10 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.placement_group_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure placement_group_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Hetzner Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster"]
      requirement["Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enforce Anti-Affinity Spread in Placement Groups"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-iam", label: "Hetzner API token and project permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: HTZ-BP-0925"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-k8s", label: "Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-audit", label: "Hetzner Cloud action log and audit trail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_storage_encryption_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enable Storage Box Encrypted Subaccounts & ZFS Snapshots (Tier-11 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: BSI C5 Cloud Standard, SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_volume"
  not r.change.after.encryption
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure encryption for compliance standard BSI C5 Cloud Standard", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Elevation of Privilege: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Mandate Real-Time Action Log Collection & Telemetry

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_audit_telemetry_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Mandate Real-Time Action Log Collection & Telemetry (Tier-12 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, EU Sovereign Cloud
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_network"
  not r.change.after.metrics
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure metrics for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Hetzner Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster"]
      requirement["Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Mandate Real-Time Action Log Collection & Telemetry"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-iam", label: "Hetzner API token and project permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: HTZ-BP-0927"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-k8s", label: "Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-audit", label: "Hetzner Cloud action log and audit trail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_tls_enforcement_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-1 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_load_balancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure tls_enabled for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Tampering: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_private_networking_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-2 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure network_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Hetzner Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster"]
      requirement["Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-iam", label: "Hetzner API token and project permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: HTZ-BP-0929"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-k8s", label: "Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-audit", label: "Hetzner Cloud action log and audit trail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_firewall_whitelist_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-3 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: BSI C5 Cloud Standard, SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_firewall"
  not r.change.after.rules
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure rules for compliance standard BSI C5 Cloud Standard", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_ssh_key_only_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enforce ED25519 SSH Key Authentication without Passwords (Tier-4 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, EU Sovereign Cloud
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_ssh_key"
  not r.change.after.public_key
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure public_key for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
threat_model.defense_barrier: Hetzner Cloud Firewall Rule Filter & Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_automated_backups_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules (Tier-5 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.backups
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure backups for compliance standard ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Hetzner Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster"]
      requirement["Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Mandate Daily Automated Backup Schedules"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-iam", label: "Hetzner API token and project permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: HTZ-BP-0932"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Hetzner Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-k8s", label: "Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:hetzner-audit", label: "Hetzner Cloud action log and audit trail", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container application on a managed Kubernetes cluster
developer_guide.contract: Service port, Pod targetPort, readiness path and immutable image digest
dependencies: A reachable cluster API and an image registry
A namespace, workload identity and network policy capable CNI
An ingress or gateway controller when external access is required
steps: Push an image by immutable digest and grant registry pull access.
Apply Deployment, Service and any ingress configuration.
Verify endpoints and readiness before exposing traffic.
tests: Check rollout status and populated Service endpoints.
Remove a replica and verify normal requests continue.
Exercise the configured ingress and egress denial paths.
failures: ImagePullBackOff: inspect registry identity and image digest.
Service timeout: inspect selectors, readiness, targetPort and CNI rules.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
hcloud context active
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package hetzner.hetzner_k8s.hetzner_k8s_high_availability_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster: Enforce Anti-Affinity Spread in Placement Groups (Tier-6 Production Kubernetes (hcloud-k8s & CSI))
# Compliance: CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Remote brute-force or unauthorized packet ingress targeting Hetzner Kubernetes Cluster
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "hcloud_server"
  not r.change.after.placement_group_id
  msg := sprintf("Hetzner resource %v must configure placement_group_id for compliance standard CIS Hetzner Linux Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Hetzner CLI: hcloud k8s list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
